context: Two managers run through a quarterly team performance review
purpose: Teach: カリキュラム/端的/低迷/探索/活力/値する/自称/称し

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今期の評価会議、端的に言うと営業チームの数字が低迷していますね。
lines.en: For this quarter's review, to put it bluntly, the sales team's numbers are slumping.
lines.style: Professional female manager, calm and direct opening tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうなんだよ。原因の探索を続けているんだが、研修カリキュラム自体に問題がある気がする。
lines.en: Right. I've been searching for the cause, and I suspect the training curriculum itself has issues.
lines.style: Male manager, thoughtful and slightly concerned, mid-level register.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 確かに、現場の活力が落ちているのは私も感じています。
lines.en: Indeed, I've also felt that morale on the floor has been dropping.
lines.style: Female manager agreeing, soft but professional delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 田中くんなんか自称エースだったのに、最近は数字がまったく伴っていない。
lines.en: Take Tanaka, who called himself the ace, but lately his numbers don't back that up at all.
lines.style: Male manager, slightly exasperated but measured critique.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 自分をリーダーと称している割に、後輩の指導は全然できていませんよね。
lines.en: Despite calling himself a leader, he isn't mentoring the juniors at all.
lines.style: Female manager, sharp critical observation, professional tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 佐藤さんの方がよほど昇進に値すると思うよ。地道に成果を出している。
lines.en: I think Sato is far more deserving of promotion. She's quietly delivering results.
lines.style: Male manager, supportive recommendation with conviction.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 賛成です。来期はカリキュラムを見直して、チーム全体に活力を戻しましょう。
lines.en: I agree. Next quarter let's revise the curriculum and bring energy back to the whole team.
lines.style: Female manager, decisive closing with forward-looking resolve.
